name: Speed ramp (RS2)
description: Slow motion around a reel's moment: from just before the kill the piece plays at `factor` for `sec` seconds, then catches up at `catchUp` times speed until it is back on its own clock, so the piece keeps its length (captions, name, music and joins stay where they were). Picture by a setpts time map, sound by atempo on each part (kept in sync) or muted over the ramp (`audio`: mute); one ffmpeg run, the sound encoded once. Used by reel styles (D412) when the examples show a ramp (UNVERIFIED on real examples); tunable in Settings > Clips > Reel styles. No flash. Flag reel-styles.
